notes.title: JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
notes.content:
[h3][b]🔥 Join Our Community & Help Shape [i]Push Through Hell[/i]! 🔥[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re opening the doors for passionate players, creators, and curious minds to be part of the journey as we build [i]Push Through Hell[/i] — a chaotic, action-packed roguelike top-down shooter.[/p][p]Your feedback isn’t just welcome — it’s a core part of how this game will evolve. We want your ideas, your suggestions, and yes… even your wildest “what if?” moments.[/p][p][/p][h3]🗨️ [b]Join our Discord here:[/b]
[/h3][p][url="https://discord.gg/hUAtScW5VF"]https://discord.gg/hUAtScW5VF[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inside the server, you’ll get:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Playable prototypes[/b] — try early builds before anyone else.
💬 [b]A direct channel to the dev[/b] — share your thoughts and get answers.
📝 [b]Design discussions[/b] — help us shape mechanics, balance, and progression.
👀 [b]Exclusive sneak peeks[/b] — new models, art, and experimental features.
📢 [b]A place to be heard[/b] — your feedback can directly influence the final game.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you live for roguelikes, can’t get enough of top-down shooters, or just want to be part of a game’s creation from the ground up, this is your chance.[/p][p]Let’s make something amazing together. See you in Hell. 😈[/p][p]— [i]Kamil Graca[/i][/p]
